prompt.text:
For a project, Kayla recorded the heights of 21 people in her neighborhood. The histogram
summarizes the heights, in inches (in), of these 21 people in Kayla’$s$ neighborhood. The first bar
represents people with a height of at least 51 in but less than 53 in. The second bar represents
people with a height of at least 53 in but less than 55 in, and so on.

How many of these 21 people in Kayla’$s$ neighborhood had a height of at least 51 in but less than
55 in?

$y=2,100($a$)x$
The given equation, where $a$ is a positive constant, gives the predicted number of bacteria, $y$, in a
growth medium $x$ hours after the number of bacteria was initially measured. According to the
equation, what was the predicted number of bacteria initially measured in the growth medium?

A right square prism has a height of 20 units. The volume of the prism is 2,880 cubic units. What
is the length, in units, of an edge of the base?

$$16x+2y=12y+8$$
$$ty=\frac{1}{2}+8x$$
In the given system of equations, $t$ is a constant. If the system has no solution, what is the value
of $t$?

$$3|3x-3|=4$$
What is the sum of the solutions to the given equation?

A rectangle has a width of $n$ yards and a length of $(n+3)$ yards. If the rectangle has an area of 340
square yards, what is the value of $n$?

$$4(cx+4)/2=6x-4$$
In the given equation, $c$ is a constant. If the equation has no solution, what is the value of $c$?

$$g(x)=\frac{1}{3}(2x)(71)$$
The function $g$ gives the volume, in cubic units, for a right square pyramid that has a base area of
71 square units and a height of $2x$ units. If the height of the pyramid increases by 1 unit, by how
many cubic units will the volume increase?

Right rectangular prism $X$ is similar to right rectangular prism $Y$. The surface area of right
rectangular prism $X$ is 64 square centimeters $(\mathrm{cm}2)$, and the surface area of right rectangular
prism $Y$ is $4,096 \mathrm{cm}2$. The volume of right rectangular prism $X$ is 17.5 cubic centimeters $(\mathrm{cm}3)$.
What is the volume, in $\mathrm{cm}3$, of right rectangular prism $Y$?

The mass of object A is $438\%$ of the mass of object $B$, and the mass of object A is $0.073\%$ of the
mass of object $C$. If the mass of object $C$ is $p \%$ of the mass of object $B$, what is the value
of $p/1,000$?
